errors.mixed_column_types.message: The column mixes data types (for example numbers and text).
errors.not_implemented.message: This feature is not implemented yet.
errors.range_has_error_values.message: The range contains error values (such as #N/A) and this operation does not support them yet.
errors.range_has_formulas.message: The range contains formulas and this operation would turn them into values. Confirm converting formulas to values first.
errors.too_large_for_history.message: The change is too large to record in the history.
errors.unknown_column.message: No column with this name exists in the data.
errors.unsupported_target.message: This operation cannot run on this kind of target.
errors.version_unavailable.message: This table version is no longer available.
errors.would_overwrite.message: This operation would overwrite non-empty cells outside the range.
